name: io.github.zyvorai/guestkit
title: GuestKit
description: Read-only evidence and boot-readiness tools for one VM disk image, offline.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount the directory holding the disk image read-only, as host_dir:container_dir:ro.

vm_dir.description: Absolute host directory containing the VM disk image.

packageArguments.description: In-container path of the disk image to serve (qcow2, raw, vmdk, ...), under /vms.

image_file.description: File name of the disk image inside the mounted directory.

packageArguments.name: --target
packageArguments.description: Boot-readiness target hypervisor: kvm, proxmox, hyperv or cloud.
